responsibility: Provides the x86 AVXNECONVERT intrinsic interface for narrow-precision broadcast and conversion operations involving BF16 and FP16 inputs. It enables avxneconvert and defines wrappers for broadcasting narrow scalars to float vectors and converting even/odd BF16 or FP16 lanes to packed single-precision results, plus float-to-BF16 narrowing helpers, exposing this specialized conversion ISA subset through GCC builtins.
